'Whenever this deals damage to a hero, destroy target aura they control.'

Trigger: ON_DEAL_DAMAGE maps to the 'damage_dealt' event (trigger_types.py:74), which engine._dsl_deal_damage_listener dispatches to the ATTACK CARD itself (engine.py:1749-1754) - Caress IS the attack card, so it hears its own damage. The event only fires when net damage > 0 (engine.py:2116-2140), which is 'deals damage'; a fully blocked attack triggers nothing. ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (combat.attack_target is None) excludes hits declared at an ally/Spectra aura - 'damage_dealt' emits for those too.

Destroy clause: DESTROY_PERMANENT {subtype: Aura, player: OPPONENT} - the cut_through_the_facade_red triage precedent for exactly this wording. Auras are a SubZoneView over player.permanents (state.py:869), so the handler's permanents pool sees them; with several opposing auras the controller picks one (_ask_player); if they control none, nothing is destroyed.

DEVIATION, flagged: the release notes make this a TARGETED triggered effect - the aura must be chosen when the trigger goes on the stack, and with no legal aura the trigger never goes on. Triggered-layer target declaration is a known engine gap, so this draft instead lets the trigger resolve and destroy nothing (fails closed: no spurious destruction, but the trigger 'fires' where printed it would not).

No printed keywords; the Action - Attack body needs no authoring.
